name: Tund
description: Tund was a hidden planet located in the mysterious Tund system, within the Centrality sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square U-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the Toong species and became home to Ben Quadinaros, a Toong Podracer pilot that claimed to be from the Tund system.
lead_paragraphs: Tund was a hidden planet located in the mysterious Tund system, within the Centrality sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square U-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the Toong species and became home to Ben Quadinaros, a Toong Podracer pilot that claimed to be from the Tund system.
The Sorcerers of Tund were a group of Force practitioners from Tund.
